summary: Frontend-only verification of dashboard profile-switch cache UX (v10.2.15/16) + cross-page delete tombstones (v10.2.16). (1) PROFILE SWITCH SPEED: PASS in settled state — after prefetch warmed (~8s post-load), ALL switches rendered with NO skeleton: Scalper 417ms, Intraday 377ms, switch-BACK to Scalper 125ms (INSTANT, in-memory cache hit ✓), Intraday-back 454ms, Swing 554ms. Cold first-tap on Scalper (cache miss, tapped immediately at load): skeleton appeared at 296ms (instant ✓), cards at 2914ms (fetch land — slightly over the ~1-2s guide but preview-env acceptable). EDGE CASE (minor bug): rapid-switching profiles while a previous profile fetch is still in-flight caused a skeleton flash on switch-back (skeleton at 194ms, cards at 1008ms) — cache did NOT serve instantly in that race. (2) CONFLUENCE v9 ('longterm'): PASS — loads in 696ms via prefetch cache hit with no skeleton; the previously-missing prefetch entry now works. (3) DELETE SYNC CROSS-PAGE: PASS both directions — (A) seeded fake CLOSED ETHUSDT trade (test-del-sync-001), visited /trades-position first to poison its page cache, deleted via swipe→HAPUS on /asi-bot (card vanished immediately), returned to /trades-position: card NOT shown immediately, at 2s, or at 7s (tombstone filtered even the stale disk-cache paint); backend DELETE confirmed (Mongo doc gone). (B) reverse with SOLUSDT (test-del-sync-002): populated /asi-bot cache first, swipe-deleted on /trades-position via new testID tp-del-SOLUSDT, returned to /asi-bot: card absent immediately/2s/7s; Mongo doc gone. (4) NO REGRESSION: PASS — dashboard renders, no console errors, no red screen/panic (only known RN-web deprecation warnings). Both fake docs cleaned from Mongo (verified count=0).

ui_bugs.issue: RAPID-SWITCH RACE: switching to another profile while the previous profile's fetch is still in-flight makes switch-BACK miss the instant cache (skeleton flashed at 194ms, cards at ~1s) instead of the guaranteed instant cache hit. Likely cause: in load() (index.tsx ~607-645) `nextData` is assigned inside the setData updater but read synchronously by setDashboardCache — if React defers the updater, the cache stores stale/empty data (empty right after a cache-miss switch zeroes data[]); there is also no stale-response guard so an in-flight old-profile response can overwrite the new profile's state.
Symbol text truncated at 375px ('ETHUSDT/U...', 'IT/U...' when swiped) — known cosmetic issue from iter44, still present.

TTL expiry also verified implicitly: a stray partial-delete tombstone from a failed attempt correctly expired after 2min and the card re-appeared (good anti-lockout behaviour).

dashboardCache.ts prefetch now includes 'longterm' (Confluence v9) and prefetchAllProfiles staggers 5 profiles x 350ms after first load AND on modal open — verified: every profile switch was skeleton-free once prefetch had ~8s to warm.

Race condition residue in index.tsx load(): nextData captured via setData updater side-effect is read synchronously for setDashboardCache — works only because React currently evaluates the first queued updater eagerly; fragile and breaks under the rapid-switch path (observed skeleton on switch-back). Also missing stale-response guard for in-flight cross-profile fetches.

rca_of_issue: Delete-sync original bug: asi-bot and trades-position each kept their own anti-resurrect set + page cache (asibot-trades:{id} vs trades:{id}), so a delete on one page never propagated — the other page re-painted the card from its stale cache or next poll. Fix (v10.2.16, /app/frontend/src/lib/deletedTrades.ts): shared module-level tombstone Map + AsyncStorage persistence with 2min TTL; markTradeDeleted() called on optimistic delete in BOTH pages; filterDeletedTrades() applied to cache paints AND poll results in BOTH pages. Verified end-to-end in both directions including the stale-disk-cache first paint. Residual minor issue: rapid profile-switch race on dashboard (see ui_bugs) — root cause candidate documented for main agent.
